title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements Exchange Policy
content:
The exchange policy is the store's own policy for the **Vehicle Purchase Agreements**. It is separate from any cancellation right of the protection products sold with the vehicle, which follow their own charters.

## Conditions of an exchange return
1. **Signed request.** A delivered vehicle may be returned under the exchange policy only on the buyer's signed exchange-return request recorded for the deal.
2. **Status.** An exchange return is accepted only on a deal in delivered status.
3. **Window.** The return must be requested within the deal type's exchange window, in calendar days after the delivery date. The delivery date is day 0, and the window includes the whole last day.
4. **Miles.** The miles driven since delivery are the odometer reading on the request less the odometer at delivery. They may not exceed the deal type's exchange mile limit.
5. **No exchange right; damage.** A deal type whose exchange window is 0 has no exchange right. A vehicle returned damaged beyond normal use is not accepted.

## Settlement of an accepted return
- The store posts the deal type's restocking fee.
- For the miles driven beyond the deal type's free miles, the store posts an exchange mileage charge: those miles multiplied by the deal type's per-mile exchange charge. Nothing is posted when the miles do not exceed the free miles.
- Every other charge on the deal is reversed in full.
- Lender funding is returned to the lender.
- The buyer's own payments are refunded, less the two exchange charges.

## Hypothetical illustrations (a deal type with a 5-day window, 250-mile limit, 100 free miles, 0.50 per mile, 295.00 restocking fee)

| Request | Outcome |
|---|---|
| day 5 after delivery, 180 miles driven | accepted; mileage charge 80 miles at 0.50, which is 40.00, plus 295.00 restocking |
| day 6 after delivery | not accepted: outside the window |
| day 2, 260 miles driven | not accepted: over the 250-mile limit |
| day 3, 90 miles driven | accepted; no mileage charge, 295.00 restocking |
